name: Black Trader
source:
The leader of the secret society 'Black Fund' and the foster father of Tesla and Nine. He is a methodical realist who prioritizes results over the process. After the organization was destroyed, no one saw him again.

[Translated from the [url=https://twin-angel-psp.com/character6.html]official site[/url]]
